question.text: EBITDA of INR 20 crore at 10x EV/EBITDA gives enterprise value of:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook defines Enterprise Value as the value of the business regardless of financing and describes EV/EBITDA as a firm-value multiple. Applying it: Enterprise Value = EBITDA x EV/EBITDA multiple = 20 x 10 = INR 200 crore. The Trap: INR 20 crore ignores the multiple. INR 100 crore uses a 5x multiple. INR 2,000 crore multiplies by 100 instead of 10 — a decimal-place trap. Note: The earlier explanation was generic placeholder text. It has been replaced with the source-backed EV/EBITDA calculation drawn directly from the workbook's relative-valuation discussion.
